answer.rationale: Prior evidence shows shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, adoption, and 30-day retention, while signup simplification produced a durable SMB activation lift. Although the competitor’s price cut creates pressure, the only tested pricing response increased acquisition but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, undermining sustainable qualified revenue. Run a standard, controlled onboarding simplification experiment rather than matching the discount; treat pricing as an unverified, high-downstream-risk option and reassess when verification capacity returns.
